transcript.text: Bosch integrated dishwasher showing E:15 and the pump keeps running. Model SMV4HTX31E. I've turned it off and on, still there

[Heading: Water-protection (anti-flood) system activated - water in base pan; drain pump runs, cycle locked (close tap)]
E:15 on your Bosch dishwasher means: Water-protection (anti-flood) system activated - water in base pan; drain pump runs, cycle locked (close tap). Tell me what it's doing when the code shows — for example whether it stops part-way or won't start — and I'll help you narrow it down.
It appeared mid-cycle two days ago and now it won't wash at all, the drain pump just hums away constantly. Unplugging it for 24h got me one cycle then E:15 came back.

Thanks for letting us know about the leaks and pumping. Please follow these safety steps before checking anything: switch the machine off and unplug it first, then turn the water off at the tap the machine is connected to. Next, check where the inlet hose connects at both the tap under the sink and the dishwasher end for drips, a loose fitting or a split. Hand-tighten only, using no tools. Was a connection loose (and is it tight now), is the hose damaged, or is it dry?

I can't pull the unit out, it's integrated under the worktop and the socket is in the cupboard behind it. I did look under the plinth with a torch though and can see a little shine of water in the base tray through a gap. No water on the kitchen floor.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Water near the plug or socket is dangerous. Please don't touch the plug, socket or machine if they or your hands are wet. If you can do it safely, switch off the circuit at the consumer unit (fuse box), keep away from the water, and don't use the machine again until a qualified electrician or appliance engineer has checked it.
